summary: Video Courses Phase 1 (Discovery/Purchase) tested end-to-end. Backend: 21/21 pytest cases passed (categories with counts, catalog filter by category=banking→3 and ssc→1, sort=price_low/high, course detail with 8 features and curriculum, coupon AVISION25 with 25% cap ₹1000, free enroll idempotent, my-enrollments, continue-learning, pay/config, order create with coupon → final_price=1125 for AVISION25 on ₹1499, order rejected 400 when already enrolled, 404 for unknown course, coupon 404 for invalid code, coupon auth required). Frontend: All required testIDs are present. Landing tab loads with search, category chips (Banking/SSC/Railway/etc.), category banner switching on chip tap, popular courses cards (banking=3), sort menu, and 'My Courses' FAB. Card tap navigates to /video-courses/{id}. Detail page renders hero with course name/exam/meta chips, stats overlap (600+ HD Videos / 15k+ Practice / 5 Subjects), What's Included grid (8 cells), Curriculum accordion (Subject → Chapter → Lectures with FREE pill), Faculty rail, Coupon input+hints (AVISION25/FIRST50/STUDENT15). Enrolled state correctly hides coupon and shows 'Start Learning' with testID `vc-continue-learning`. Unenrolled IPM course shows Buy Now (`vc-buy-now`) and coupon input. My Video Courses screen renders the enrolled Banking course with progress bar (0% • 0 videos watched). Regression: /live-class still redirects to /live-courses. No red-screen errors, no deprecated Expo packages detected. Minor: RN-Web warning 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' (comes from expo-linear-gradient / third-party — non-blocking).
critical_code_review_comments: video_courses.py: create_order does not check if _db is None (unlike free_enroll/detail which do). If init fails, first call would crash with AttributeError. Low risk — server startup wires init_video_courses(db) — but consider parity for safety.

Frontend courses.tsx: `load(cat)` in category chip onPress uses the new cat but subsequent sort changes call `load()` which uses `selectedCat` from closure — works fine, but could race with rapid chip taps. Minor.
video_courses.py: `_get_rzp` reads env every call but only reinitialises when client is None; if credentials are rotated at runtime the cached client stays. Non-blocking.
video_courses.py: continue_learning sorts by `last_activity_at` but new enrollments only set it at creation; two enrollments with same time may not order deterministically. Fine for MVP.
seed_data_creation: Free-enrolled test@avision.com into vc-banking-2026 during pytest run (idempotent).
